name: Catalog
descr: The sections of the main catalogue: the tree itself, the rights on it, the options hung on it and the alternative catalogues built over it. Every row of an answer says what this person may do on that very section, so read the list before promising anything. The goods themselves are not touched here - only the places they hang in, and the Place tool moves them.

commands.name: CmdListCut
commands.descr: Reads the sections of the catalogue and nothing beside them. The rights, the alternative catalogues and the option rows come with CmdListFull.

commands.name: CmdListFull
commands.descr: Reads the catalogue whole - the sections, the rights standing on them, the nodes of every alternative catalogue and the option rows set: four tables in one answer.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a section under a parent. The rights of the parent are copied onto it, so the same people own it; the parent itself must be yours to shape.

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the section it goes under; 1 is the root of the catalogue

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the section, unique among them

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the section

params.name: intro
params.descr: the short text of the section

params.name: descr
params.descr: the long text of the section

params.name: no_visible
params.descr: true - the section is off the storefront, false - it is shown

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of TOPIC_KIND_KEY; kLink needs link with it

params.name: link
params.descr: where a kLink section leads

params.name: seo_psu
params.descr: the address of the page of the section

params.name: seo_title
params.descr: the title of that page

params.name: in_xml
params.descr: true - the goods of the section go into the xml feed

params.name: templ_key
params.descr: a value of TOPIC_TEMPL_KEY - the view the storefront shows it with

params.name: order_key
params.descr: a value of TOPIC_ORDER_KEY - what the goods of the section are sorted by

params.name: order_asc
params.descr: true - that sorting runs backwards, despite the name of the column

params.name: option_code
params.descr: the option code of the section

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of sections, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the section, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the section, unique among them

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the section

params.name: intro
params.descr: the short text of the section

params.name: descr
params.descr: the long text of the section

params.name: no_visible
params.descr: true - the section is off the storefront, false - it is shown

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of TOPIC_KIND_KEY; kLink needs link with it

params.name: link
params.descr: where a kLink section leads

params.name: seo_psu
params.descr: the address of the page of the section

params.name: seo_title
params.descr: the title of that page

params.name: in_xml
params.descr: true - the goods of the section go into the xml feed

params.name: templ_key
params.descr: a value of TOPIC_TEMPL_KEY - the view the storefront shows it with

params.name: order_key
params.descr: a value of TOPIC_ORDER_KEY - what the goods of the section are sorted by

params.name: order_asc
params.descr: true - that sorting runs backwards, despite the name of the column

params.name: option_code

commands.name: CmdMove
commands.descr: Moves a section under another parent, with its whole branch. Both the section and the new parent must be yours to shape, and a section cannot move inside its own branch.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the section to move

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the section it goes under; 1 is the root of the catalogue

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes sections by id, with everything lying under them. The first call counts the sections and the goods it touches, the second one does it: the goods stay in the store, and the ones left hanging nowhere are reached by the Lost tool alone.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the section, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdRightAdd
commands.descr: Grants a right on sections, to a person or to a group: one row of topic_right on each of them. One of user_id and group_id, never both.

params.name: topic_id
params.descr: id of the section, or several of them

params.name: user_id
params.descr: id of the person the right belongs to

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group the right belongs to

params.name: for_frame
params.descr: true - the descriptions of the goods of that section are theirs

params.name: for_price
params.descr: true - the prices of the goods of that section are theirs

params.name: for_ctrl
params.descr: true - the section itself is theirs to shape and to place goods in

params.name: for_browse
params.descr: true - the section is theirs to look through in the Browse window, without the right to edit

commands.name: CmdRightUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the rows of topic_right, by id - CmdList answers them with their ids.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of topic_right, or several of them

params.name: user_id
params.descr: id of the person the right belongs to

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group the right belongs to

params.name: for_frame
params.descr: true - the descriptions of the goods of that section are theirs

params.name: for_price
params.descr: true - the prices of the goods of that section are theirs

params.name: for_ctrl
params.descr: true - the section itself is theirs to shape and to place goods in

params.name: for_browse
params.descr: true - the section is theirs to look through in the Browse window, without the right to edit

commands.name: CmdRightRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of topic_right by id. A section left with no rights on it is seen only by whoever holds PUT_TOPIC_RIGHT.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of topic_right, or several of them

commands.name: CmdKeyAdd
commands.descr: Sets an option on sections: one row of topic_key_set on each of them. The option and its value must stand in the tree of the section options, and a stray id is refused; the sections must be yours to shape.

params.name: topic_id
params.descr: id of the section, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the topic_key table of CmdList answers them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them - topic_key_value of CmdList

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the rows of topic_key_set, by id - CmdList answers them with their ids. A row keeps whatever the call leaves out, and the pair it will stand with is weighed against the tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of topic_key_set, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the topic_key table of CmdList answers them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them - topic_key_value of CmdList

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of topic_key_set by id. The option itself stays in the registry.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of topic_key_set, or several of them

commands.name: CmdAltAdd
commands.descr: Adds a node of an alternative catalogue under a parent of the same catalogue. Every node stands for a section of the main catalogue - the name may differ, the section may not be missing, and a node pointing at nothing is swept away.

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of TOPIC_ALT_KIND_KEY - which alternative catalogue it is; one table holds them all, and this is what tells them apart

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the node it goes under; 0 is the top of that catalogue

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the node

params.name: topic_id
params.descr: id of the section of the main catalogue this node stands for

commands.name: CmdAltUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the nodes of the alternative catalogues, by id.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the node, or several of them

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the node

params.name: topic_id
params.descr: id of the section of the main catalogue this node stands for

commands.name: CmdAltMove
commands.descr: Moves a node of an alternative catalogue under another parent of the same catalogue, its branch with it. The node and the parent are named by id, and kind_key says which catalogue they belong to; 0 as a parent puts the node at the top.

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: the alternative catalogue the nodes stand in - a value of TOPIC_ALT_KIND_KEY in the base settings; one call takes the nodes of one catalogue

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the node to move

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the node it goes under; 0 is the top of that catalogue

commands.name: CmdAltRemove
commands.descr: Deletes nodes of one alternative catalogue with the branches under them. The first call counts what goes, depend does it. The sections they point at stay as they are.

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: the alternative catalogue the nodes stand in - a value of TOPIC_ALT_KIND_KEY in the base settings; one call takes the nodes of one catalogue

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the node, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused
